name: Fish Absolutely
summary: A small fishing charter on Absolutely, a 36 foot Jersey Dawn sportfisher with twin fighting chairs, outriggers and a flybridge. Trips run from a three hour reef session to full days offshore for marlin, tuna, wahoo and mahi-mahi, plus a fish and snorkel half day and an evening sunset trip. Drinks and snacks come with every charter.
standouts: 36 foot Jersey Dawn sportfisher with twin fighting chairs, outriggers and a live bait well
Beer, rum, soft drinks, water and snacks included with every charter
Full-day and extended trips include a freshly prepared lunch
Air-conditioned cabin and shaded flybridge seating

trips.title: Reef Runner (3hrs)
trips.summary: A three hour reef fishing trip with light, steady action on the rods. It suits friends and families who want a relaxed first go at fishing.
highlights: Suited to friends, families and casual anglers
trips.checkNotes: No prices on the page; prices, if any, sit inside the Acuity Scheduling widget in the page's Book section, which was not opened. The trip's Book Now button opens an email to info@deepseafishingbarbados.com.

trips.title: Fish & Snorkel Escape (4hrs)
trips.summary: A half day that starts with light tackle fishing and finishes with a swim and snorkel on a reef. Snorkel gear and drinks are on board.
highlights: Light tackle fishing, then a reef snorkel stop
Suited to couples, families and groups
trips.checkNotes: No prices on the page; prices, if any, sit inside the Acuity Scheduling widget in the page's Book section, which was not opened. Snorkels listed from the trip text; drinks and snacks from the site-wide note that they come with every charter.

trips.title: Offshore Slam (8hrs)
trips.summary: A full day of sportfishing in offshore waters, targeting marlin, mahi-mahi, tuna and wahoo. The cockpit is fully rigged and a crew runs the gear, with lunch made on board.
highlights: Targets marlin, mahi-mahi, tuna and wahoo
Fully rigged cockpit and experienced crew
trips.checkNotes: No prices on the page; prices, if any, sit inside the Acuity Scheduling widget in the page's Book section, which was not opened.

trips.title: Marlin Quest (10hrs)
trips.summary: A ten hour, tournament style offshore charter with heavy tackle and outriggers, set up for blue marlin, tuna, wahoo and other open ocean fish. It is aimed at private groups of keen anglers.
highlights: Heavy tackle and outriggers for blue marlin
trips.checkNotes: No prices on the page; prices, if any, sit inside the Acuity Scheduling widget in the page's Book section, which was not opened.

trips.title: Sunset Drift (3hrs)
trips.summary: An evening trip that mixes light trolling or reef fishing with a slow cruise as the sun goes down. Rum punch is served on deck.
trips.checkNotes: No prices or departure time on the page; prices, if any, sit inside the Acuity Scheduling widget in the page's Book section, which was not opened.

trips.title: Custom Trip (2-7+ days)
trips.summary: Private multi-day fishing and cruising trips built around the group, on the sportfisher alone or paired with a catamaran mothership for island hopping. Itineraries can include offshore fishing, reef snorkelling and nearby islands.
highlights: Two to seven or more days, fully private
Option to pair with a private catamaran mothership
Add-ons include a private chef, dive and snorkel trips and tournament entries
trips.checkNotes: Site says Contact to book; booking by email only. No prices shown.

checkNotes: Single-page Squarespace site; the sitemap lists only the home page (last modified 2026-01-19). The site never states where trips depart from; two photo descriptions mention the boat docked at Port St. Charles, so town and departsFrom are left null. The only phone shown is 604.868.9316, a Canadian area code, not a +1 246 number. Book buttons open an email (info@deepseafishingbarbados.com, cc fishabsolutelybarbados@gmail.com); an Acuity Scheduling widget sits in the Book section of the home page. No prices anywhere on the page. An embedded social post on the home page says the boat was being shipped via St Martin to St Lucia, and another mentions Ft. Lauderdale; confirm the boat is now operating in Barbados.
